vulnerability_analysis: The contract has owner-only functions that allow draining BNB from the contract. The clearStuckBalance() function transfers a percentage of contract BNB to marketingFeeReceiver, and manualSend() transfers all BNB. The marketingFeeReceiver can be changed via setFeeReceivers() function. An attacker who gains owner/authorized access can set marketingFeeReceiver to their address and drain all BNB.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the owner, change marketingFeeReceiver to attacker address, fund the contract with BNB, then call clearStuckBalance(100) to drain 100% of BNB to attacker.
step_by_step_plan:
1. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the contract owner
2. Call setFeeReceivers() to set marketingFeeReceiver to attacker address
3. Send BNB to the contract using deal() or direct transfer
4. Call clearStuckBalance(100) to drain all BNB
5. Verify attacker balance increased
